people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
translations.bsb: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
translations.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
